# Bell Enviro

> Principal-delivered environmental consultancy based in the Darwin rural area (Humpty Doo), Northern Territory, Australia. Serves civil head contractors, subcontractors, developers and interstate consultancies with contaminated land and PFAS investigations, construction environmental management plans (CEMPs), environmental audits and inspections, environmental approvals, cultural heritage/AAPA coordination and a retainer 'environmental department as a service'. Fixed-price packages. Principal: Chris Bell. Phone 0424 577 159. Email chris@bellenviro.au.

Service regions in priority order: (1) Darwin, Palmerston and the Litchfield rural area; (2) the Top End including Katherine, Kakadu/Jabiru, Arnhem Land, Nhulunbuy and the Tiwi Islands; (3) the wider Northern Territory and the East Kimberley region of Western Australia (Kununurra, Wyndham, Halls Creek).

## Services
- [Asbestos testing, registers and hazmat surveys](https://bellenviro.au/services/asbestos-hazmat-darwin/): Asbestos sampling with NATA-accredited identification, asbestos registers and management plans, pre-demolition hazmat surveys and Class B clearance inspections in Darwin, Palmerston and the NT. Licensed assessors brought in for friable and Class A work.
- [Soil testing in Darwin and the Top End](https://bellenviro.au/services/soil-testing-darwin/): Soil sampling and testing in Darwin, Palmerston and the rural area: contamination screening, waste classification of fill and excavated material, PFAS, acid sulfate soils and asbestos in soil. NATA labs, results explained.
- [PFAS testing, investigation and management](https://bellenviro.au/services/pfas-investigation/): PFAS testing of soil, groundwater and surface water in Darwin and the NT, done to the PFAS NEMP. Sampling, waste classification and management plans for civil works near the airport, RAAF base and East Arm.
- [Bore water, surface water and discharge testing in Darwin](https://bellenviro.au/services/water-testing-darwin/): Bore water, groundwater, surface water, dewatering and discharge sampling in Darwin, Palmerston and the rural area, with NATA-accredited analysis and results explained against drinking water, irrigation and NT EPA criteria.
- [Environmental approvals, NT EPA referrals and permits](https://bellenviro.au/services/environmental-approvals/): NT EPA referrals, environment protection licences, land clearing and water permits, and approvals advice for projects in Darwin, the Top End and the NT.
- [Sacred site clearances (AAPA certificates) and cultural heritage](https://bellenviro.au/services/cultural-heritage-aapa/): AAPA Authority Certificate applications, heritage due diligence, Traditional Owner engagement and archaeological survey coordination for projects anywhere in the NT.
- [Environmental management plans (CEMPs) and ESCPs](https://bellenviro.au/services/construction-environmental-management-plan/): Contract-ready CEMPs, erosion and sediment control plans, weed hygiene and dust and noise plans for NT Government, Defence and council civil works. Fixed price, usually within five to ten business days.
- [Contaminated land assessment: PSI and DSI](https://bellenviro.au/services/contaminated-land-assessment/): Preliminary and detailed site investigations (PSI/DSI) in Darwin, Palmerston and across the NT. Done to the ASC NEPM, fixed price, written and signed by the person who did the work.
- [Flora and fauna surveys](https://bellenviro.au/services/flora-fauna-surveys/): Flora and fauna (wildlife) surveys, threatened species checks and vegetation assessments for land clearing permits, development applications, Defence works and CEMPs in Darwin, the Top End and the NT.
- [Environmental audits, inspections and compliance](https://bellenviro.au/services/environmental-auditing-compliance/): Independent environmental audits, site inspections, monitoring programs and incident systems for civil works in Darwin and across the NT. Findings written as actions, not pages of observations.
- [Your environmental department, as a service](https://bellenviro.au/services/environmental-department-as-a-service/): A monthly retainer that gives NT civil contractors an environmental scientist on call for advice, document reviews, incident response and priority delivery of CEMPs, audits and investigations, without hiring one.
- [Compliance, stockpile and incident registers](https://bellenviro.au/services/compliance-registers/): Simple obligations, stockpile and incident registers for civil contractors, set up and kept honest by Bell Enviro so the evidence is there when the auditor or the principal asks.

## Regions
- [Darwin, Palmerston and the rural area](https://bellenviro.au/regions/darwin-palmerston-rural/): Darwin-based environmental consultant covering Darwin, Palmerston, Humpty Doo, Howard Springs, Berry Springs, Noonamah, Coolalinga and the Litchfield rural area. Contaminated land, PFAS, asbestos, CEMPs, audits and approvals.
- [The Top End](https://bellenviro.au/regions/top-end/): Remote-capable environmental consultant for the Top End: Katherine, Kakadu and Jabiru, West and East Arnhem Land, Nhulunbuy, the Tiwi Islands, Daly River and the Victoria River district.
- [The rest of the NT and the Kimberley](https://bellenviro.au/regions/northern-territory-kimberley/): Environmental consulting across the Northern Territory and north-east WA: Tennant Creek, Alice Springs, the Barkly, Kununurra, Wyndham, Halls Creek and the East Kimberley.

## Guides
- [Do I need a CEMP for NT Government or Defence civil works?](https://bellenviro.au/guides/do-i-need-a-cemp-for-nt-government-works/): When a Construction Environmental Management Plan is required on NT Government, Defence and council contracts, what has to be in it, and how to get it approved first time.
- [PSI vs DSI: which contaminated land assessment do you need in the NT?](https://bellenviro.au/guides/psi-vs-dsi-contaminated-land-nt/): The difference between a Preliminary Site Investigation and a Detailed Site Investigation under the ASC NEPM, when each is needed in the NT, and roughly what they cost.
- [PFAS testing for civil works around Darwin: what contractors need to know](https://bellenviro.au/guides/pfas-testing-civil-works-darwin/): Where PFAS is a problem for civil works around Darwin, when excavated soil needs testing, and what the PFAS NEMP means for reusing or disposing of material.
- [Weed hygiene declarations for NT civil works: what's required](https://bellenviro.au/guides/weed-hygiene-declaration-nt/): What a weed hygiene declaration is, when NT Government and land council contracts require one, and how to set up wash-down and inspection procedures that stand up at audit.
- [NT EPA referral: when a project needs one and how it works](https://bellenviro.au/guides/nt-epa-referral/): When a project has to be referred to the NT EPA under the Environment Protection Act 2019, how the pre-referral screening tool works, what goes in a referral and how long it takes.
- [Land clearing permits in the NT: when you need one and how to apply](https://bellenviro.au/guides/land-clearing-permit-nt/): When clearing native vegetation in the NT needs a permit under the Planning Act, what the Land Clearing Guidelines require, the exemptions, and how to put together an application that gets approved.
- [AAPA Authority Certificates: what they are, when you need one and how long they take](https://bellenviro.au/guides/aapa-certificate-nt/): How AAPA Authority Certificates work in the NT, why most government and Defence contracts require one, how to apply, and what it costs and how long it takes.
- [Gamba grass and weed management plans for Darwin rural blocks and civil sites](https://bellenviro.au/guides/gamba-grass-management-plan/): Gamba grass obligations for landholders and contractors around Darwin, what a weed management plan under the NT Weeds Management Act has to contain, and how to meet them without it taking over your life.
